name: Liquidation cascade fade: OI drop >3% with >1.5 ATR bar
author: akira777777
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
entry_long: On a closed 15m bar: OI rate of change (1 poll) <= -3% AND |close - previous close| >= 1.5 x ATR(14) AND price fell -> BUY (long-liquidation cascade fade).
entry_short: OI ROC <= -3% AND bar rose >= 1.5 x ATR -> SELL (short-liquidation cascade).
exit: No exit in the strategy module (signal only); confidence scales with OI drop magnitude (0.60 at -3% to 1.0 at -9%).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Needs open-interest history; exit/stop must be supplied by the orchestrator.
